title: Backend Engineering Intern
company_overview: We build scalable, distributed microservices handling hundreds of thousands of transactions per minute with sub-second latencies.
responsibilities: Design and build RESTful and gRPC APIs using Python (FastAPI/Django) or Go.
Model relational database schemas and optimize query execution plans in PostgreSQL.
Implement asynchronous task workers and distributed caching using Redis and Celery/RabbitMQ.
Write thorough unit, integration, and load tests to safeguard service reliability.
required_skills: Solid understanding of Python or Go and object-oriented / modular software design.
Hands-on experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), relational schema design, and queries.
Understanding of REST API design principles, HTTP protocols, and status codes.
Foundational knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and computational complexity (Big-O).
preferred_skills: Experience with async Python (FastAPI/AsyncIO) or Go goroutines/channels.
Familiarity with Redis caching patterns, pub/sub, or message brokers.
Basic knowledge of Docker containerization and CI/CD pipelines.
cultural_competencies: Strong ownership and attention to edge cases and data integrity.
Comfort working in a collaborative team with regular code reviews.
Proactive problem solver who asks good questions early.
